title: feat: add @object-ui/console-server package
body:
Packages the console app as a reusable Hono server plugin so any ObjectStack project (e.g., HotCRM) can serve the admin UI by adding one plugin to the kernel.

### New package: `packages/console-server`

- **`ConsolePlugin`** — ObjectStack kernel plugin that registers static file serving routes on the Hono app
- Auto-resolves client files from bundled `client/` dir (npm publish) or `apps/console/dist` (monorepo dev)
- SPA fallback routing, directory traversal protection, pre-compressed `.gz`/`.br` serving
- Configurable `basePath`, `skipPaths`, `compression`, cache headers
- `build:client` script copies console dist into package for standalone publishing
- 10 unit tests

### Updated: `examples/crm`

- Uses `@object-ui/console-server` instead of inline `console-plugin.ts`

### Usage

```ts
import { ConsolePlugin } from '@object-ui/console-server';

// Serve at root
await kernel.use(new ConsolePlugin());

// Or mount at a sub-path with custom options
await kernel.use(new ConsolePlugin({
  basePath: '/console',
  skipPaths: ['/api', '/graphql', '/auth'],
}));
```
